scope: Legal holds service blocking concurrent deletion and retention expiration while active, durable reason and attribution auditing, custody ledger mirroring, and restart persistence

commands.output: Validated 40 detailed tasks, resources, references and progress; no runtime capability inferred.
Passed all 11 tests in cmd/breachatlas and all test suites in tests (C05 through C13, including 5 C13 legal hold concurrency, restart, negative, and immutability tests).
Plan validation, TypeScript check, Vite build, and 29 web/contract tests passed.
VALIDATION PASSED: Checked repository JSON files and contract invariants.

observations: OpenService, PlaceHold, ReleaseHold, DeleteEvidence, ExpireRetention, GetEvidenceStatus, and AuditTrail in internal/holds/service.go enforce active legal hold precedence over deletion and automated retention expiration.

Every hold placement, release, blocked deletion/expiration attempt, and allowed post-release disposal writes an attributable durable AuditEntry with exact reason and blocking hold IDs, mirrored cleanly to custody.LedgerStore when attached.

Concurrent goroutines calling PlaceHold, DeleteEvidence, and ExpireRetention under go test -race serialize deterministically; active holds block removal with ErrHoldActive while preserving mutual exclusion in unheld races.

Missing prerequisites (nil SealStore, unsealed evidence, empty actor/reason, invalid RFC3339 timestamps, missing/invalid paths), malformed fixtures, corrupted persisted state or audit files, and unsupported providers fail closed with typed errors.
Active holds and audit logs survive Close() and OpenService() restarts and continue blocking deletion and retention expiration after restart.
Sealed evidence source bytes remain byte-for-bit identical across all hold, blocked delete/expire, release, and disposal operations.

observed_limitations: HTTP API exposure and web UI controls for legal holds belong to later workflow wiring commits.
rollback_or_recovery_observation: Revert internal/holds/service.go, tests/hold_test.go, tests/fixtures/breachatlas/C13, and docs/evidence/C13.json. No database schemas, migrations, .env files, or Dockerfiles were modified.
